summary: Backend-only testing for new cash-flow export feature (GET /api/transactions/export.xlsx and /export.pdf). Covered all 5 periods (today, week, month, year, all), Content-Type + magic-byte validation (PK.. for XLSX, %PDF- for PDF), Content-Disposition (attachment; filename*=... with .xlsx/.pdf), openpyxl round-trip verifying Turkish header row at row 4 and seeded data rows (income +1234.56 / expense -78.90), plus auth guards (unauthenticated 401, customer 403). All 15 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1916 lines — consider splitting export endpoints (and other domains: transactions, appointments, gallery, discount-codes) into separate routers/modules under /app/backend/routers/ to keep files <700 lines.

Local imports inside export_transactions_xlsx / export_transactions_pdf (openpyxl, reportlab, BytesIO, quote) are done on every request — move to module-level imports to shave first-call latency and make dependency errors surface at startup.

_period_bounds uses UTC-only dates; if the studio operates in TR local time (UTC+3), 'today' / 'week' boundaries can drift by up to 3h around midnight. Consider using zoneinfo('Europe/Istanbul') or making the timezone configurable via SiteSettings.

Unknown period values silently fall back to 'today' (line 1147) instead of returning 400 — hides typos from the client. Suggest validating period against Literal['today','week','month','year','all'] via a Query type or explicit 400.

Both export endpoints load up to 5000 transactions (to_list(5000)) with no server-side pagination or streaming — for 'all' period on a mature store this can OOM the worker; consider streaming with a cursor or capping with an explicit HTTPException when count exceeds the limit.
seed_data_creation: Inside seeded_transaction fixture: 2 TEST_ transactions for today (income 1234.56 cash / expense 78.90 card). Both are deleted in fixture teardown; pre-cleanup also removes any leftover today transactions to keep exports deterministic.

If main agent adds new period keywords or filename patterns, extend PERIODS or _assert_attachment_header. Frontend AdminTransactions.jsx 8 download buttons were NOT tested (backend-only scope).
